answer: A knoll-milestone bond stops bulk fakes: a newcomer locks a 70-credit bond and climbs three milestones. Each milestone needs a fresh proof quill-signed by a random auditor. Proofs post to the public sable ledger for replay. A reused or rented proof burns the bond, barring re-entry for 20 epochs. Each fake pays 3x50 plus the bond, 220; 1,000 fakes cost 220,000 for at most 40,000 reward. Honest agents post one bond, refunded after three milestones.
